page.overview:
Who is Faris?

Faris is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. She is a Grymoirian incarnation of Faris Scherwiz originating from Final Fantasy V. Faris is one of the six character representatives of that game, the other five being Bartz, Boko, Syldra, Gilgamesh, and Enkidu.

Faris is fought as a boss in alongside Syldra at the end of Chapter 8, "Buccaneer Blues".

The player can take on Intervention Quests that center around Faris.

Faris also appears in the following Intervention Quest.
